cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Bioinformatician to join our team, contributing to life science and therapeutic research programs. The role involves statistical support for ongoing studies on reprogrammed and differentiated cell lines, developing analytical pipelines for next generation sequencing data, and applying technologies such as RNASeq, whole genome sequencing, epigenetic analysis, and proteomics to solve problems in human health.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Perform data analysis (s/mi/mRNAseq, whole genome assembly, SNP, BisSeq, ChIPseq) with in-house and externally generated NGS data.
Assist scientists in interpreting experimental results.
Manage in-house and publicly available data collections in support of these analyses.
Evaluate publicly available analysis methods for applicability to research goals.
Organize, script and document analyses to ensure reproducibility.
Ensure data and analysis integrity through self-directed review.
Support ongoing development projects in bioinformatics and data management.
Educate scientific staff on bioinformatics best practices and developments.
Develop new methods of analysis as needed.
Other job functions as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, Computer Science or related field, or bachelor's degree in a related field plus 2 years of relevant experience.
3 Years of relevant professional experience in computational biology with demonstrated achievements and progressive responsibilities.
Experience with computational biology tools and methods (BWA, GATK, Trinity, Bioconductor, Soap2, Galaxy, BLAST, others).
Programming experience (Perl, Python, R, bash).
Unix/Linux experience including shell scripting, basic commands, and utilities.
Strong communication skills and being organized.
Able to work at a computer for extended periods of time.
Preferred Requirements
Relational database experience (MySQL, MS SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres).
Experience in proteomics, mass spec, and image analysis.

Working as part of the Data Sciences team, you will help develop robust analytical pipelines for a wide range of next generation sequencing data, and work alongside team members to apply technologies such as RNASeq, whole genome sequencing, epigenetic analysis, and proteomics to address important problems in human health.
cond_0270.responsibilities:
Coordinate with in-house scientists to perform data analysis (s/mi/mRNAseq, whole genome assembly, SNP, BisSeq, ChIPseq) using both in-house and externally generated NGS data.
Support [Company name masked] scientists in interpreting experimental results.
Help manage in-house and publicly available data collections in support of these analyses.
Work with the team to evaluate publicly available analysis methods for applicability to research goals.
Organize, script, and document analyses together with colleagues to ensure reproducibility.
Help ensure data and analysis integrity through shared review processes.
